_comment: broca-machina ECHO example — the simplest possible brain. It just repeats your words back, so you can verify the whole audio loop (mic -> STT -> brain -> TTS -> speaker) before wiring a real LLM. Replace every /ABS/PATH/TO/... below with real absolute paths and fill in the discord IDs. allowAnySpeaker:true is safe HERE because echo has no privileges — for any real brain, set discord.allowedUserId to your user ID instead. See README.md in this folder.
